title: How Much Fiber in Kiwi? 2.1g per Kiwi
description: Kiwi: about 2.1 g of fiber per 1 kiwifruit (7% DV), from USDA FoodData Central. Portion table, comparisons, free calculator.
h1: How much fiber is in kiwi?

answer.note: USDA FoodData Central, Kiwifruit, green, raw

intro: Kiwi ranks #14 of 15 fruits on this site for fiber per serving. Every figure below is scaled from USDA FoodData Central, the same data the calculator uses.

dataTable.caption: Fiber in kiwi by portion
dataTable.note: Fiber and calories are scaled from USDA FoodData Central per-100 g values (rows listed under Sources). % Daily Value uses the 28 g reference on U.S. Nutrition Facts labels. Brands, ripeness, and cooking change real values.

sections.heading: How much fiber is in kiwi?
paragraphs: USDA FoodData Central lists kiwifruit, green, raw at 3 g of fiber per 100 g. One serving (1 kiwifruit; 69 g) therefore has about 2.1 g of fiber and 42 calories. That is 7% of the 28 g Daily Value on U.S. Nutrition Facts labels, or 8% of a 25 g day and 5% of a 38 g day.

Kiwifruit is small, so one fruit gives a couple of grams of fiber. It has drawn research interest because, in clinical trials, eating two green kiwifruit a day improved bowel movement frequency in people with chronic constipation.

sections.heading: Kiwi skin and the “two a day” habit
paragraphs: The fuzzy skin of green kiwi is edible and adds fiber, although USDA’s entry is for peeled fruit. If the texture is fine for you, washing and eating the skin gives a bit more.

Studies on kiwifruit and constipation typically used two green kiwifruit per day for several weeks. If you try it, give it time and keep fluids up; for ongoing constipation, a clinician can check for other causes.

sections.heading: How kiwi compares with other fruits
paragraphs: Of the 15 fruits on this site, kiwi ranks #14 for fiber per typical serving and #7 for fiber per calorie. That works out to 4.9 g of fiber per 100 calories, a high ratio: you get a lot of fiber for the calories.

Close neighbors by serving: [dates](/fiber-in-dates) at 1.6 g (1 Medjool date); [mango](/fiber-in-mango) at 2.6 g (1 cup pieces); [strawberries](/fiber-in-strawberries) at 2.9 g (1 cup, whole). Across all 50 foods in the [fiber-in-foods table](/fiber-in-foods), kiwi is #25 for fiber per calorie.

sections.heading: Adding kiwi to your day
paragraphs: Two kiwis with breakfast is a simple routine. They also work sliced into yogurt or blended into a green smoothie.

Example: 2 kiwifruit, 170g greek yogurt, 2 tbsp wheat bran. Using the same USDA values as the calculator, that comes to about 7.2 g of fiber, with 4.1 g from the kiwi. Adjust the amounts in the calculator to match your plate.

faqs.q: How much fiber is in 100 g of kiwi?
faqs.a: 3 g, according to USDA FoodData Central (Kiwifruit, green, raw). That is the figure every portion on this page is scaled from.

faqs.q: How much fiber is in kiwi (2 kiwifruit)?
faqs.a: About 4.1 g, for 138 g. Weigh your portion or edit grams in the calculator for a closer estimate.
Yes, the skin of green and gold kiwi is edible. Wash it well. It adds some fiber and texture.
Several clinical trials found two green kiwifruit a day improved stool frequency in adults with constipation. It is a reasonable food-first option, not a replacement for medical advice.
